officialTaxonomyMiddleSchool.note: 예고·체고 is ONE combined leaf in the guideline table (예술고+체육고 not separate TOTAL leaves). 영재학교 is under 기타, not a separate TOTAL leaf.

TOTAL5.evidence: Unique gap between anchored TOTAL4(특성화고) and TOTAL6(외고·국제고) in official 12-leaf order.

TOTAL7.evidence: Unique gap between anchored TOTAL6 and TOTAL9 in official leaf order (예고·체고 combined leaf).

TOTAL8.evidence: Unique gap between TOTAL7 slot and anchored TOTAL9.

TOTAL9.evidence: Guideline leaf #7 + screen anchor (displayed as 자사고 on third-party UI; product uses official 자율형사립고).

TOTAL10.evidence: Unique gap between anchored TOTAL9 and TOTAL11.

TOTAL12.evidence: Official non-advancer leaf #10 after 기타; 12-leaf bijection.
